en: Changed `sandbox.excludedCommands` to ignore project and local settings entries when managed settings or `--settings` set `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`, or managed `allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`
zh: 变更 `sandbox.excludedCommands`：当托管设置或 `--settings` 设置 `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`，或托管设置 `allowManagedDomainsOnly: true` 时，忽略项目和本地设置中的条目
